sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding pump housing ph-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 4,000 pcs per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We appreciate your counter-offer and the prospect of a 24-month contract, but we kindly request formal confirmation of the 4,000 pieces per year to fully factor this volume into our calculation.
Building on your preferred 30-day payment terms and the extended contract duration, we are prepared to offer a revised price of €51.30.
Our colleagues will address your request for a cost breakdown separately, as we maintain a strict policy regarding our internal calculations.
Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.
Which volume can you commit to?
Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €50.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 February 2027.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We have noted your improved offer and the proposed effective date of April 2027.
To accommodate this later start date while maintaining your preferred 30-day payment terms, we are prepared to lower our price to €50.00.
We are making steady progress, and I am confident we can bridge the remaining gap to continue our successful cooperation.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and valid from 1 April 2027: €50.00 per unit.
Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
We have supplied you reliably for years and expect fairness in return.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
